scripts.dev: npm run -w @payflow/shared build && concurrently -n shared,web,api -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run -w @payflow/shared build:watch" "npm run -w @payflow/web dev" "npm run -w @payflow/api dev"
scripts.build: npm run -w @payflow/shared build && npm run -w @payflow/web build && npm run -w @payflow/api build
scripts.lint: npm run -w @payflow/web lint && npm run -w @payflow/api lint
scripts.build:web: npm run -w @payflow/shared build && npm run -w @payflow/web build
scripts.build:api: npm install && npm run -w @payflow/shared build && npm run -w @payflow/api db:generate && npm run -w @payflow/api build
